name: [💼] My Working Brainrots
desc:
💼 My Working Brainrots

👍 Like the game & join the group

How to Play:
📦 Pick up crates on the conveyor
🕵️ Unbox a crate to get a Brainrot
🛠️ Place your Brainrot in the Workspace
💰 Earn and collect Cash
⚙️ Upgrade your Conveyor

⭐ Your Brainrots literally keep working while you’re offline!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile & Tablet
